name: mapfre.com.mx
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But all touch targets must be 24px large, or leave sufficient space.
lesson: Make every link and button at least 24 by 24 px, with space between them.
summary: www.mapfre.com.mx scores 72 out of 100 (C). 5 checks fail now, 22 are at risk, and 33 pass. Fix first: all touch targets must be 24px large, or leave sufficient space.

fix.title: All touch targets must be 24px large, or leave sufficient space
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 9 elements on /seguro-de-viaje/, for example .swiper-pagination-bullet-active and span[aria-label="Go to slide 2"]. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Make tap targets at least 24 by 24 px, or leave that much space around them.

fix.title: 1 JSON-LD block does not parse
fix.evidence: On /seguro-de-viaje/. A block that is not valid JSON is ignored by Google and by AI crawlers.
fix.fix: Validate each block with the Schema Markup Validator and fix the JSON.

fix.title: 2 front-end libraries have known flaws
fix.evidence: swiper 5.4.5 (banner of /contents/lib/dg-divi-carousel/scripts/swiper.min.js): 1 known flaw, the worst rated critical, such as CVE-2021-23370. Versions of the package swiper before 6.5.1 are susceptible to prototype pollution. Moment.js 2.30.1 (banner of…
fix.fix: Upgrade swiper to 6.5.1 or later; upgrade Moment.js to 2.31.0 or later. A major upgrade changes behavior, so retest the pages that use it.

fix.title: Tracking starts on load and no banner asks first
fix.evidence: No cookie banner appeared. Before any choice, Chromium from an EU address (Belgium) saw Google Analytics (1 request), Google Ads (1 request), and cookies _ga, _ga_1234, _ga_CS6K4JPKVM, _fbp.
fix.fix: Hold every tag until consent, or set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads. Block third-party embeds until the visitor agrees.

fix.title: Links must have discernible text
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 3 elements on /, /seguro-de-viaje/, /empresas/, for example .et_pb_image_0_tb_footer > a[href$="buro/"]. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Give each link text, or an aria-label when it only holds an icon.

fix.title: Referrer-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Browsers fall back to their default. An explicit policy keeps full URLs from leaking to other sites. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.
